component.name: Eduvanta
component.summary: Institutional Academic and ERP Desktop Platform

description.p: Eduvanta is a modern academic and institutional enterprise desktop application built with Tauri and React. It provides comprehensive tooling for managing higher-education institutions, courses, admissions, faculty, and student records.

ul.li: Curriculum and Course Management with multi-tier admission criteria
Faculty and Departmental Staff Directory with credentials management
Student Enrollment and Admissions Processing with automated notification dispatches
Integrated Fee Accounting, payment ledger tracking, and receipts
Institutional Media Gallery and Campus Notice Board

description.p: Initial release of Eduvanta Desktop application featuring:

ul.li: Interactive course catalog and curriculum management
Faculty directory with image upload support
Admission review workflow and fee management
